about: Edits the page editor makes to documents in pageDocuments.json, as the updates it sends (apps/web/src/memory/live/pageDocuments.test.ts writes them, from a fixed client id). The server checks it takes each one and writes the Markdown given. Rewrite with UPDATE_DOC_PARITY=1.
